newsitem.title: USA: Knight-Ridder sees Q1 EPS $0.45 - $0.50 shr.
newsitem.headline: Knight-Ridder sees Q1 EPS $0.45 - $0.50 shr.

text.p: Knight-Ridder Inc expects to report first quarter earnings per share of between $0.45 to $0.50 when the newspaper company announces results for the period, expected April 22.

"Forty-five to fifty cents per share is good, and we have been saying on the high side of forty-seven (cents per share)," a company spokesperson told Reuters after the conclusion of the company's annual meeting here.

Chairman Anthony Ridder said in his remarks to shareholders that the $1.65 billion acquisition of four newspapers from Walt Disney Co announced April 4 will raise the Miami company's debt-to-capital ratio to 47 from the current level of 36 through 1998.
The company will return to the pre-deal debt-to-capital ratio within three years, he said.

Ridder said the price for the newspapers, which include the Kansas City Star and the Fort Worth and Arlington Star-Telegram, "is a fair one, especially considering the size and quality" of the assets.
Under terms of the newspaper acquisition, Knight-Ridder will exchange $660 million of convertible preferred stock for the Disney assets, while assuming $990 million of debt.
